name: Western Swamphen
rangeDescription: Iberian peninsula and northwestern africa (morocco to tunisia)
description: Distinctive large waterbird, much larger than a moorhen. Deep purplish-blue overall with a very stout red bill, reddish legs, and a white undertail patch.

name: Sunda Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula, and greater and lesser sundas
description: Typical Cuculus cuckoo: most adults are gray with black stripes on a white breast and belly, but some females are “hepatic”; they appear rufous overall with extensive barring. Virtually identical to Himalayan and Oriental cuckoos, which migrate through and winter in Sunda’s range; look for Sunda’s more contrasting darker gray upperparts, wider bars on the underparts, and buffier unmarked vent.

name: White-fronted Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Central and southern dominican republic
description: A chunky, iridescent, deep-purple dove of dense forests and coffee plantations. It is typically found on the ground walking among the leaf litter, sometimes in company of Ruddy or Key West Quail-Doves.

name: Rufous-breasted Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: West slope of andes of peru (la libertad to ica)
description: Rare and endangered bird found at high elevations in the western Andes of northern and central Peru. Note the black mask and the reddish-orange eyebrows, throat, and breast.

name: White-eared Catbird
rangeDescription: Northwestern new guinea eastward to southeastern cenderawasih bay, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A large, shy, stocky bird of lowland and foothill forest interior of western New Guinea. A dark brown crown edged with black, contrasting with white cheek and throat, containing small black dots forming an uneven moustache.

name: Tamarugo Conebill
rangeDescription: Southwestern peru (arequipa and tacna) to northern chile (tarapacá)
description: Very local. Breeds commonly (September to March) in groves of tamarugo trees in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile; most birds then migrate north to foothills of the Andes in northern Chile and southern Peru.

name: Brown-fronted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Northern baluchistan and western himalayas (afghanistan to northern india and nepal)
description: A common mid-sized woodpecker of the Himalayas. Note brownish forehead, dark cheek stripe, distinctive black barring on white back, and white spots on black shoulders and wings.

name: Everett's Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Philippines (bohol, samar, biliran, leyte, mindanao, and basilan)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland and foothill forest. Dark brown on the back with barred wing feathers, grayish underparts, a darker chest with black markings, a pale gray facial disk bordered with a black line, and pale ear tufts forming a V.

name: Antipodes Parakeet
rangeDescription: Locally in antipodes islands
description: Entirely green parakeet endemic to the subantarctic Antipodes Islands. The largest of New Zealand’s native parakeets.

name: Pied Crow
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa, madagascar, aldabra, and comoros
description: Handsome black-and-white crow. Found in almost all habitats except driest desert and thick rainforest.

name: Slaty-backed Forktail
rangeDescription: Rocky mountain streams of northern india to southern china and southeastern asia
description: The only forktail in its range for which the adult has a gray back and crown; pattern is otherwise similar to that of Black-backed Forktail, which it overlaps partially in range. White on the head is restricted to a thick eyebrow that reaches behind the eye--instead of a full crown--giving it a more small-headed appearance than White-crowned and Spotted forktails.

name: Copper-throated Sunbird
rangeDescription: Mangroves and scrub of southeastern asia, palawan, and greater sundas
description: Large sunbird of mangroves. Male is completely covered with iridescence and can appear dark all over; look out for glistening wine-red throat and overall blue-green tones in good lighting.

name: Green Figbird
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (rote, semau, and timor)
description: Male figbird is a distinctive oriole with a moss-green body and a black head with bright red facial skin. Female is brown, with a heavily streaked lighter underside and dull blue-gray or pinkish facial skin.

name: Santa Cruz Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Tinakula and utupua (northern and central temotu, southeastern solomon islands), and vanuatu
description: A rotund, short-legged ground-dwelling dove that usually runs rather than flies when startled. Male has a dark body with an iridescent pinkish-purple shoulder patch, a cream-colored chest, and a gray head.

name: Spot-billed Toucanet
rangeDescription: Atlantic forest of southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Small multicolored toucan with an olive-green back, bare blue skin around the eyes, a red vent, and a chestnut-tipped green tail. The bill is grayish with three black bars.

name: Golden-crowned Emerald
rangeDescription: Western mexico (southern sinaloa to durango, guerrero, and oaxaca)
description: Very small, fork-tailed hummingbird endemic to western Mexico. Favors scrubby woodland, forest edge, and flower banks; mainly in drier habitats.

name: Volcano Swiftlet
rangeDescription: Mountains of java
description: A Javan endemic, this rare and enigmatic swiftlet breeds in the craters of a handful of active volcanoes. Forages over the craters and surrounding montane forest.

name: Cinnamon-tailed Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid pacific slope of southern mexico (oaxaca and western chiapas)
description: Very local and often elusive sparrow endemic to the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Found in brushy woodland and edge of tropical lowlands on Pacific slope.

name: Rusty-breasted Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western sumatra
description: Chunky babbler of the forest floor and understory in Sumatra’s highlands. Mostly dark brown, with a white throat, dark scaling on the upperparts, and the namesake rust-colored breast.

name: White-gorgeted Fantail
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: Slender, with a long, often fanned tail. Dark above, with a white throat and belly, as well as a boldly white-streaked black chest.
